verdict.rationale: Grafana's self-managed stack lets users decide where data physically lives: Loki stores log chunks in S3, GCS, or a local filesystem, and runs locally as a single binary. Mimir can also be self-run in monolithic mode, and Grafana queries data sources wherever they're stored. There is no evidence of region or residency selection for the hosted Grafana Cloud offering, so control over location comes mainly from self-hosting. Missing for 10: documented Grafana Cloud region/data-residency selection, explicit residency or compliance documentation, independent corroboration.
